name: appendicitis and diverticulitis overview
title: Migrating lower abdominal pain with fever: right-sided appendicitis (ultrasound, usually surgery) or left-sided diverticulitis (CT, uncomplicated managed as an outpatient, abscess or perforation escalating to drainage or surgery), plus painless diverticular bleeding and stricture, each with presentation, numbered investigations and treatment in order

root.title: Migrating abdominal pain + fever: RIGHT (appendix) or LEFT (diverticula)?
lines: both are an OBSTRUCTED, inflamed pouch, and both are very common
antibiotics for both: ceftriaxone + metronidazole, OR a carbapenem or piperacillin-tazobactam alone

groups.title: LEFT: suprapubic → left lower quadrant
lines: rare < 35 · rises each decade · obesity, poor diet
